preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of magnets n is between 3 and 2000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: There are at least 2 magnets whose type is not '-' and at least 1 magnet of type '-'.
preconditions.description: The magnets contain at least two types other than '-' and at least one '-'.

postconditions.expression: The output is a sequence of queries and answers.
postconditions.description: The output consists of a series of queries to the interactor, each followed by the response from the interactor.

postconditions.expression: The final answer is printed in the format '! k A' where k is the number of demagnetized magnets and A is a list of their indices.
postconditions.description: The final answer is printed after all queries are made, indicating the end of the test case.

invariants.expression: The machine is not broken by any query.
invariants.description: The interactor ensures that the machine does not crash due to the force produced by any query.

invariants.expression: The number of queries does not exceed n + floor(log2(n)).
invariants.description: The number of queries made by the solution does not exceed the allowed limit.
